answer: Attention-Debt Ledger. Each identity must post a continuous stream of small, unpredictable micro-tasks answered within seconds; missing any window marks a debt. Like tending a willow, presence must be maintained. A cedar-tagged audit trail records gaps, and repeated misses raise task frequency. A juniper threshold of three missed windows freezes the identity until cleared. A sybil operator pays sustained attention per fake identity, making thousands of bots prohibitively costly in labor and time.
